$comment: Tasks for the IonBase eval. Enterprise SaaS shapes, not 'make a button'.
Each task names the traps it is really testing. That is the point: a corpus
of vague asks measures nothing, because every grader disagrees about what
good looks like. `expects` is machine-checkable; `traps` is what we expect
an unhelped model to get wrong, and is what makes a failure diagnostic
rather than just a low score.
Coverage is deliberately skewed to the states agents omit — empty, loading,
error — and to the choices that type-check either way.

`dark-mode-check` was removed on 2026-08-18. The dark theme is not settled in Figma yet, so a task that grades output on dark-mode legibility would be grading against values that are still moving. Restore it — and its known-contrast trap, which is the most discriminating one in the corpus — once Dark comes out of deferral in contrast-exceptions.json.

tasks.prompt: Build a user management table: columns for name, email, role and status. Support filtering by role, selecting rows in bulk, and a bulk deactivate action. Include empty, loading and error states.
traps: selection checkboxes with no accessible name

tasks.prompt: Build a billing settings page with a plan summary and a 'Cancel subscription' flow. Cancelling is irreversible.
traps: two primary buttons in the modal
no cancel path out of the dialog

tasks.prompt: Build an 'Invite teammate' form: email address, role dropdown, optional message. Validate the email and show a field-level error.
traps: own <label htmlFor> instead of the label prop
error text in description instead of errorMessage

tasks.prompt: Build an API keys page: a table of keys with created date and last used, a 'Create key' button, and per-row revoke. Show the new key exactly once after creation.
traps: icon-only row actions with no aria-label
no empty state for zero keys

tasks.prompt: Build a notification preferences panel: several on/off settings grouped into sections, with a save bar that appears when something changes.
traps: Select with two options instead of Toggle

tasks.prompt: Build an audit log view: a dense table of events with timestamp, actor, action and target, filterable by date range and actor. Thousands of rows.
traps: default density for a dense log
no empty state when filters match nothing
no aria-label on the scroll region

tasks.prompt: Build a three-step onboarding wizard: workspace details, invite teammates, pick a plan. The user can go back, and can save and exit.
traps: validation deferred to the final step

tasks.prompt: Build an integrations page: a grid of available integrations, each showing name, description, and a connect/disconnect action. Some are already connected.
A background export job has failed. Show the user a persistent message on the page explaining it and offering a retry.
The user just saved their profile successfully. Confirm it without disrupting the page.
In a team members table, let an admin change another member's role inline. Downgrading the last admin must be prevented.
traps: no feedback when the change is blocked

tasks.prompt: Build a search results page for documents. Handle the case where the query matches nothing, and the case where the search itself fails.
traps: no way to clear the query

tasks.prompt: Build the 'Danger zone' section of workspace settings: transfer ownership, and delete the workspace. Deleting is permanent.
Show a workspace's seat usage against its plan limit, and warn when it is close to the limit.
Build a CSV import flow: upload, preview the parsed rows, show per-row validation problems, then confirm the import.
Build an active sessions list in security settings: device, location, last active, and a 'Sign out' action per session plus 'Sign out everywhere'.
A long settings form failed validation in four places, some of them scrolled out of view. Show the user what went wrong.
traps: summary that does not link to the fields

tasks.prompt: Show a project settings page to a user who has view-only permission. Everything is visible but nothing is editable.
traps: disabled with no explanation of why

tasks.prompt: Build a filter toolbar above a records table: a text search, two dropdown filters, and a 'Clear filters' action. It should sit in a dense layout.
Build the application shell: a top header with the product logo and a user menu, and a left sidebar with primary navigation.
traps: Button used for navigation instead of Link

tasks.prompt: In a list of saved reports, add a delete action to each row.
traps: destructive variant on a non-destructive action

tasks.prompt: A dashboard page loads its data asynchronously. Show the user what is happening before the data arrives.
traps: spinner that shifts layout when replaced

tasks.prompt: Build a plan comparison for an upgrade page: three tiers, features per tier, and a call to action on each. Mark the recommended plan.
Build a webhook detail panel: endpoint URL, the events it subscribes to, recent delivery attempts with status, and a 'Send test' action.
traps: no empty state for no deliveries

tasks.prompt: Build two-factor authentication setup: show a QR code, take a six-digit verification code, and display one-time recovery codes afterwards.
traps: recovery codes with no copy or download
no warning that codes are shown once
no error state for a wrong code

tasks.prompt: Build a comment thread on a record: existing comments with author and timestamp, and a composer to add one. Handle the empty case.
traps: submit enabled on an empty composer

tasks.prompt: Build an SSO configuration form for an enterprise admin: IdP metadata URL, a certificate paste field, domain, and a test-connection action that can fail.
traps: failure shown as a status not an error

tasks.prompt: In an orders table, let a row expand to reveal line items without leaving the page.
traps: Modal used where inline detail was asked for

tasks.prompt: The API has started rate-limiting this workspace. Tell the user, inside the developer settings area, and link to the docs.
traps: Button used for the docs link

tasks.prompt: Let a user replace their profile picture: show the current one, allow choosing a new file, and handle an upload that fails.
traps: icon-only upload trigger with no name

tasks.prompt: Let a user pick a timezone from the full IANA list in an account settings form.
traps: rich content in native select options
